sources.name: Voxyz Quill Pack
observed_useful_patterns: Drafts in user voice by default
Default off-the-record; publishing requires explicit toggle
Voice samples, post history, banned words, and self-review loop
Runtime map: IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, USER.md, TOOLS.md, optional MEMORY/HANDOFF/HEARTBEAT

sources.name: Research Paper Writing Skills
observed_useful_patterns: Clarify story before sentence edits
One paragraph per message
Reverse outlining
Claim-evidence alignment
Adversarial reviewer-style review
sources.slatecamp_use: Mini-outline, reverse-outline, skeptical reviewer gate, claim-evidence map.

sources.name: Anti-AI-Slop Writing
observed_useful_patterns: Banned AI vocabulary and phrase lists
Avoid rule-of-three default, uniform sentence length, and identical paragraph structures
Concrete specifics over generic claims
Never invent anecdotes, data, studies, numbers, or quotes
sources.slatecamp_use: Anti-slop audit for articles, rationales, and reviewer memos.

sources.name: Stanford STORM research page
observed_useful_patterns: Pre-writing stage matters
Discover diverse perspectives
Simulate perspective-specific question asking against grounded sources
Curate collected information into an outline before writing
Evaluate outline quality
sources.slatecamp_use: Perspective-question pass before article drafting and outline acceptance before prose.

sources.name: Stanford STORM Discover / Co-STORM
sources.status_checked: 200 text/html; deeper use requires terms agreement and sign-in
observed_useful_patterns: Interactive knowledge curation prototype
Generated content can make mistakes
Users are warned to check important information
No personally identifiable information in inputs
